# Rahul Chanda Photography
> Commercial & Product Photography Studio based in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. Specializing in high-end product packshots, food & beverage styling, footwear catalogs, and brand advertising campaigns.

## Core Navigation & Endpoints

- [Home](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/): Single-page portfolio with commercial showcase, bio, services overview, and booking.
- [Services](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/services): Six core commercial photography disciplines, technical capabilities, deliverables, and FAQs.
- [Commercial Photographer Dehradun](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/dehradun): Local commercial landing page for Dehradun and regional Uttarakhand brands.
- [Portfolio Gallery](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/gallery): Commercial portfolio spanning luxury timepieces, skincare, food, footwear, and beverage campaigns.
- [About](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/about): Photographer profile, studio infrastructure, lighting philosophy, and 10+ years commercial experience.
- [Contact & Booking](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/contact): Inquiries, shoot briefs, estimates, phone (+91 70789 39475).
- [FAQs](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/faq): Turnaround times, commercial licensing, RAW deliverables, and studio policies.
- [Journal & Field Notes](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/blog): Commercial photography technical field notes, lighting setups, color science, and AI post-production guides.

## Commercial Photography Journal Articles

- [Commercial Photo Retouching 101: The Studio Pipeline from RAW to Final Master](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/blog/retouching-101): Step-by-step culling, ColorChecker calibration, frequency separation, and multi-format delivery.
- [Generative AI Backgrounds for Product Photography: Studio Lighting & Workflow Guide](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/blog/generative-ai-product-backgrounds): Combining physical key lights with generative environments without the cutout look.
- [AI Retouching in Photoshop: The Practical Studio Workflow & Pipeline](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/blog/ai-photoshop-retouching-techniques): Photoshop Remove tool, Generative Fill, and multi-stage batch studio pipelines.
- [How AI is Changing Commercial Product Photography](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/blog/ai-commercial-product-photography): Why physical lighting physics, label typography, and brand consistency require real cameras.
- [Why Beverage Splash Photography is Harder Than It Looks](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/blog/why-beverage-splash-photography-is-hard): High-speed flash duration (t0.1), fluid viscosity, trigger delay, and liquid crowns.
- [Essential Studio Lighting Patterns for Commercial Product Photography](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/blog/lighting-patterns-for-product-photography): Key lights, rim highlights, gradient scrims, and negative fill.
- [Footwear Photography Angles That Convert](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/blog/footwear-photography-angles): Conversion-tested e-commerce angle sequences that reduce returns.
- [AI Video Editing for Commercial Campaigns](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/blog/ai-video-editing-tools-2026): DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, and Runway in commercial brand video production.
- [AI Color Grading and Scene Detection](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/blog/ai-color-grading-scene-detection): Multi-camera color matching and timeline scene detection.
- [Photographing Glass, Bottles & Liquids](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/blog/beverage-photography-glass): Translucent backlighting, double strip boxes, black flags, and glycerin condensation.
- [AI Upscaling for E-Commerce](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/blog/ai-upscaling-ecommerce): Topaz Gigapixel vs Magnific AI, marketplace zoom thresholds, and hallucination risks.
- [Color Accuracy & Science for E-Commerce Photography](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/blog/color-science-ecommerce): ColorChecker profiling, strobe Kelvin consistency, and sRGB profile embedding.
